content.title: Divine Mercy Sunday Celebrations 2026
content.text: Divine Mercy Sunday is celebrated on the Second Sunday of Easter, the Octave of Easter, which this year is April 12, 2026. Below you will find a list of celebrations taking place in the Diocese of Portland. Click here to learn more about Divine Mercy Sunday and the plenary indulgence that may be received on that day. A guide to praying the Divine Mercy Chaplet may be found here or click here for the Divine Mercy Novena, which begins on Good Friday. Celebrations Around the Diocese All Saints Parish, Brunswick St. Mary Church, 144 Lincoln Street, Bath - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will begin with exposition of the Blessed Sacrament at 2 p.m., confessions will be heard from 2:30 p.m. to 2:15 p.m., and at 2:30 p.m. there will be a Holy Hour, which will include readings rom St. Faustina's Diary and the Divine Mercy Chaplet. Christ the Divine Mercy Parish, East Millinocket St. Martin of Tours Church, 19 Colby Street, Millinocket - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at 3 p.m. St. Peter Church, 58 Cedar Street, East Millinocket - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at 8:30 a.m. Corpus Christi Parish, Winslow St. John the Baptist Church, 26 Monument Street, Winslow - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at 3 p.m. and will include the sung Divine Mercy Chaplet, adoration, and Benediction Franciscan Monastery, Kennebunk Franciscan Monastery, 28 Beach Avenue, Kennebunk - Join in devotions and prayer at the Franciscan Monastery on Sunday, April 12, at 2 p.m. FMI, contact Carol Ingraham at cingraham58@gmail.com or 207-985-3166. Good Shepherd Parish, Saco St. Joseph Church, 178 Elm Street, Biddeford - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held Sunday, April 12, 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., at St. Joseph Church in Biddeford. It will include recitation of the Divine Mercy Chaplet, the opportunity for the sacrament of reconciliation, and readings. Holy Family Parish, Greenville Holy Family Church, 145 Pritham Avenue, Greenville - The Divine Mercy Chaplet will be recited on Saturday, April 11, at 3:30 p.m., prior to the 4 p.m. Mass. On Sunday, April 12, a Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will begin at 2:30 p.m. and include exposition of the Blessed Sacrament, the sacrament of reconciliation, the recitation of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, and Benediction. Our Lady of the Lakes Parish, Oqussoc St. John Church, 76 Main Street, Stratton - The Divine Mercy Chaplet will be recited before the Saturday, April 11, 6 p.m. Mass. St. Luke Church, 19 Lake Street, Rangeley - The Divine Mercy Chaplet will be recited before the 8 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. Masses on April 12. Our Lady of the Valley Parish, Saint Agatha St. Agatha Church, 379 Main Street, St. Agatha - The Divine Mercy Chaplet will be prayed daily at 3 p.m. from April 3 - April 11. Parish of the Ascension of the Lord, Kittery Our Lady of the Angels Church, 4 Angels' Way, South Berwick - Recitation of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy and Benediction will begin at 2:30 p.m. Parish of the Holy Eucharist, Falmouth Holy Martyrs of North America Church, 266 Foreside Road, Falmouth - The Parish of the Holy Eucharist will hold a solemn celebration of Divine Mercy from 3 to 5 p.m. on Sunday, April 12, at Holy Martyrs of North America Church. The celebration will begin with eucharistic adoration and including veneration of the Divine Mercy image, reading from St. Faustina’s diary, recitation of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, meditation, Litanies of the Sacred Heart and Divine Mercy, and Benediction. The opportunity for the sacrament of reconciliation begins at 3 p.m. and continues throughout the service. In addition, the parish invites you to join in praying the Divine Mercy Novena, which begins on Good Friday. For each of the nine days, our Lord gave St. Faustina a different intention. The novena and chaplet will be prayed following all the Stations of the Cross on Good Friday, and following the daily morning Masses and scheduled adoration from Easter Sunday to Divine Mercy Sunday. (You are encouraged to do Day 2 of the novena on your own). Novena brochures will be available at each of the parish's four church on Palm Sunday. Sign up on our website, pothe.org/divine-mercy, or visit pothe.org and navigate to the Lent 2026 tab. Join our Divine Mercy Flocknote Group. Novena prayers will be sent to your email each day! There are also resources on the webpage explaining Divine Mercy and audio and video recordings to guide your prayer. Parish of the Holy Savior, Mexico St. Athanasius & St. John Church, 126 Maine Avenue, Rumford - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will begin at 2 p.m. Parish of the Precious Blood, Caribou The Parish of the Precious Blood will hold a Divine Mercy Sunday celebration beginning at 3 p.m. at St. Denis Church, 147 Main Street in Fort Fairfield. The commemoration of the feast day will include adoration followed by the recitation of the Divine Mercy Chaplet. Parish of the Resurrection of the Lord, Old Town Parishioners are invited to begin praying the Divine Mercy Novena on Good Friday, April 3. The novena will conclude on Divine Mercy Sunday with a program at Holy Family Church, 429 Main Street in Old Town, that will include a Holy Hour and the sacrament of reconciliation beginning at 2 p.m., followed by prayers including the Chaplet of Divine Mercy at 3 p.m. Parish of the Transfiguration of the Lord, Bar Harbor Holy Redeemer Church, 56 Mount Desert Street, Bar Harbor - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will begin at 2 p.m. with the praying of the Rosary. The Divine Mercy Chaplet will be recited at 3 p.m. The sacrament of reconciliation will be available prior to the Sunday 10 a.m. Mass. Prince of Peace Parish, Lewiston Basilica of Ss. Peter & Paul, 122 Ash Street, Lewiston - Join Prince of Peace Parish from 2:30 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. for the praying of the Divine Mercy Chaplet, the Litany of Divine Mercy, the sacrament of reconciliation, and readings from Scripture and St. Faustina's Diary. St. Agnes Parish, Pittsfield St. Agnes Church, 238 Detroit street, Pittsfield - A Divine Mercy Sunday prayer service will be held at St. Agnes Church beginning at 2:30 p.m. to pray together to ask God for his mercy on our souls, the Catholic Church, our country, the world, all Christians, and individual intentions. Eucharistic adoration will be held from 2:30 p.m. to 3 p.m., followed by the recitation of the Divine Mercy Chaplet and other prayers from 3 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. St. Anthony of Padua Church, Jackman St. Faustina Church, 370 Main Street, Jackman - The Feast of Divine Mercy will be celebrated with exposition of the Blessed Sacrament, the sacrament of reconciliation, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy and Benediction beginning at 10:30 a.m., prior to the 11 a.m. Mass St. Benedict Parish, Benedicta St. Benedict Church, 1063 Benedicta Road, Benedicta - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at 10:30 a.m. St. Brendan the Navigator Parish, Camden St. Bernard Church,150 Broadway, Rockland and St. Francis of Assisi Church, 81 Court Street, Belfast - St. Brendan the Navigator Parish will hold Divine Mercy Sunday celebrations beginning at 2:30 p.m. at St. Bernard Church in Rockland, and St. Francis of Assisi Church in Belfast. The celebrations will include recitation of the Divine Mercy Chaplet and other prayers, along with exposition of the Blessed Sacrament. St. John Paul II Parish, Scarborough St. Maximilian Kolbe Church, 150 Black Point Road, Scarborough - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will begin at 2 p.m. with the opportunity for the sacrament of reconciliation. That will be followed at 3 p.m. by a eucharistic Holy Hour with the sung Divine Mercy Chaplet. The Holy Hour will conclude with Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament. St. John Vianney Parish, Fort Kent St. John Vianney Parish will hold a eucharistic Holy Hour at St. Louis Church, 26 East Main Street, Fort Kent, from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. St. Joseph Parish, Bridgton St. Joseph Church, 225 South High Street, Bridgton - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. and include the opportunity for the sacrament of reconciliation, adoration, and the praying of the Divine Mercy Chaplet. St. Joseph Parish, Ellsworth St. Joseph Church, 231 Main Street, Ellsworth - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held from 9:30 am. to 10:30 a.m. and include exposition of the Blessed Sacrament, the Divine Mercy Chaplet, and Benediction. St. Joseph Parish, Farmington A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at St. Joseph Church, 133 Middle Street in Farmington, beginning at 3 p.m. with exposition of the Blessed Sacrament. That will be followed by the Divine Mercy Chaplet., the opportunity for the sacrament of reconciliation, Benediction at 4:45 p.m., and Mass at 5 p.m. St. Louis Parish, Portland St. Louis Church, 279 Danforth Street, Portland - A eucharistic Holy Hour with the praying of the Divine Mercy Chaplet will be held at St. Louis Church in Portland on Divine Mercy Sunday from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. St. Mary of the Visitation Parish, Houlton St. Mary of the Visitation Church, 110 Military Street, Houlton - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will include the sacrament of reconciliation from 1:30 to 2:30 p.m., exposition of the Blessed Sacrament at 2:30 p.m., the praying of the Divine Mercy Chaplet in song at 3 p.m., and Benediction at 3:30 p.m. St. Paul the Apostle Parish, Bangor A Divine Mercy Holy Hour with the recitation of the Divine Mercy Chaplet will be held at St. Teresa Church, 425 South Main Street in Brewer, on Sunday, April 12, beginning at 2:30 p.m. St. Thérèse of Lisieux Parish, Sanford St. Thérèse of Lisieux Parish will hold a Divine Mercy Sunday celebration beginning at 3 p.m. at Holy Family Church, 66 North Avenue in Sanford. It will include the singing of the Divine Mercy Chaplet. Stella Maris Parish, Bucksport St. Vincent de Paul Church, 64 Franklin Street, Bucksport - A Divine Mercy Sunday celebration will be held at 3 p.m.
